name: FieldTripPermissionSlip
tagline: School trip consent, contacts, medical notes, payment and signature – one guided form for parents.
description: A Power Apps code component that replaces paper trip slips. Parents see the trip with a live reply-by countdown and places left, decide per child, add emergency contacts, medical and dietary notes, consent to activities and photos, choose how to pay (with sibling discount, deposit, instalments or financial assistance) and sign by drawing or typing. The whole response is stored as JSON in one Dataverse column, with 22 outputs for flows.
features: Trip card with countdown, places bar, itinerary and kit list
Per-child consent with year-group eligibility and waiting-list warning
Guardian and emergency contacts with validation
Medical and dietary notes with emergency-treatment consent
Required/optional activities matrix and photo consent
Sibling discount, deposit, instalments, pay later and financial assistance
Draw or type signature, declarations and receipt with reference
Deadline lock, review mode, single-page layout
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts; keyboard and screen-reader friendly
Labels, locale and brand colours configurable; React 16.14 bundled
